Verified TWO network calls (PUT /api/emissions/{id} + POST /api/calc-engine/execute-by-category dry_run=false) for 6 of 7 paths with HTTP 200 each. integration_issues.issue: PUT /api/emissions/{id} returned 200 (confirmed twice) but the post-save dry_run=false POST /api/calc-engine/execute-by-category was NOT observed in re-verification capture (with capture cleared immediately before Update click and 8s wait). For comparison, sister path S3_C2 (also Scope 3 module dispatch) consistently fires the dry_run=false audit POST with 200. Suggests the biogenic-scope3 path in /modules/emissions/index.js may be skipping persistCalcAuditLog or the helper call is gated by a condition that's false for biogenic-scope3.

rca of the issue: biogenic-scope3 PUT succeeds (200) but post-save dry_run=false POST execute-by-category not consistently captured. Likely either (a) the biogenic-scope3 module wiring in /modules/emissions/index.js routes to a buildEditPayload that doesn't invoke the dispatch branch where persistCalcAuditLog is called, or (b) the helper is called but the request fails silently (caught) without network observation — unlikely as other module paths show clean 200s. Mitigation: inspect index.js wiring for biogenic-scope3 vs generic-scope3, ensure both reach the same handleSubmit branch that calls persistCalcAuditLog after the PUT resolves with 200.
